A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 19-page DASH paper, including Appendices A–D. Extracted text and rendered pages match except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendices C–D report original long-context and vision–language experiments, including benchmark scores, measured inference efficiency, and ablations.

after.justification: The same original benchmark results, inference-efficiency measurements, and ablations remain in Section 4 and Appendices C–D.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain identical attention-delta scoring, single-shot token selection, fixed active-set reuse, and prefill halting procedures.

E1.justification: LongBench-E, LooGLE, and all vision–language datasets and test scenarios in Section 4 and Appendices C–D are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 3 retain FastV, LLMLingua2, D3, and SnapKV(pr.). Comparator membership also remains identical in every vision–language and extended appendix comparison.

E3.justification: The backbones, pruning budgets, start-layer sweeps, evaluation metrics, sample sizes, and controlled attention-kernel settings are identical, including the appendix experiments.

E4.justification: The delta-signal and directionality ablations, qualitative token example, start-layer analysis, ranking-fidelity tests, and single-shot versus multi-shot comparison are unchanged (Figures 7–8 and Appendix D).

E5.justification: Statistical and seed information is identical, including Appendix D.2's matched-seed comparisons. There are no additions or removals of repeated-run information or uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted findings are identical. For example, DASH retains a LongBench-E average of 46.76 in Table 1 and a LooGLE average of 19.94 in Table 3; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations in Section 3 and the FLOPs derivation in Appendix A, including Equations 4–10, are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free token halting, attention-kernel compatibility, and accuracy–efficiency trade-offs.

C2.justification: The token-saturation interpretation, Section 5 discussion, limitations, and Appendix C.2 qualifications concerning fine-grained visual tasks and memory/latency trade-offs are unchanged.

D1.justification: The pseudocode, fixed prefix/suffix settings, start-layer details, GPU hardware disclosures, and promised code-release information are identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, the citations and reference list, and the positioning relative to KV-cache compression, token pruning, and representation redundancy are unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp changes, from v1 (20 Apr 2026) to v2 (26 May 2026). All manuscript wording and section structure, including the appendices, remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–23, Algorithm 1, captions, and page layout are unchanged. The administrative stamp update does not alter these displays.

improvement.justification: The manuscript and all appendices are unchanged; only arXiv version/date identification differs. This administrative update neither improves nor diminishes the paper's scientific evidence, clarity, or reproducibility.
